description:
Create a 3D copper pipe system in Blender using Bezier curves.

Requirements:
1. Create at least 3 Bezier curve objects to represent pipe segments.
2. Set the 'Bevel Depth' on the curves (0.02m - 0.08m) so they form solid tubes (Geometry > Bevel > Depth).
3. Ensure at least one pipe has a visible bend (not just a straight line).
4. Create a realistic Copper material and apply it to all pipes:
   - Color: Warm orange-brown
   - Metallic: High (> 0.8)
   - Roughness: Moderate (0.2 - 0.5)
5. Arrange the pipes to look like a plumbing layout (e.g., along a wall or connecting points).
6. Render the scene (F12) and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/pipe_render.png'.
7. Save the project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/pipe_system.blend'.

Login: The desktop session is already active. Blender is open with a baseline scene.
